lead: A `peek.py` flag written *between* two targets makes it reject every target after it.
body: `peek.py A.rs:10-20 --context 4 B.rs:re:pat` fails with `unrecognized arguments: B.rs:re:pat`, because argparse cannot split one variadic positional list around an option — the same call with the flag last reads all of them. Write every target first and every flag at the end, which is how the tool's own usage line spells it.
